title: Shattered Sunrise
description: a modpack that completely reimagines Minecraft with a harder challenge
body:
Shattered Sunrise is a hardcore challenge modpack that changes the game to be harder but not grindy. 

Features 
- New Bosses
- New Dungions 
- New Armor and Wepons 
- New ways to play the game 
- ~~Lots of grind~~
- AND MUCH MORE


Shattered Sunrise is more then just random thown toghther mods everything has been added to make the game harder and better. The modpack is not for the weak so try your best to beat it. Will need at least 4 GB of ram to run.
